fields.command: git -C repo log --oneline | head && git -C repo diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat && git -C repo diff HEAD~1 HEAD
grep -rln "integrity" --include=*.py . | grep -i test; ls; mkdir -p ../tmp; TMPDIR=../tmp timeout 300 python3 -m pytest -q -k integrity 2>&1 | tail -5
grep -n "needs_scheduling\|LOGIN_NODE\|integrity\." tests/run_tests.py | head; TMPDIR=../tmp timeout 600 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | tail -8
mkdir -p tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/tmp" timeout 600 python3 tests/run_tests.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR):|^Ran|^OK|^FAILED" | head -30

rm -rf tmp && git status --short | head; cat > ../review.json <<'EOF'
{"note": "review body omitted"}
EOF
python3 -m json.tool ../review.json >/dev/null && echo valid
cd <KIT>; git -C repo log --oneline | head; git -C repo diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat; git -C repo diff HEAD~1 HEAD
cd <KIT>/repo; ls; ls tests gars/_system; grep -n "estimate_minutes" -r . ; grep -n "def estimate_minutes" -A20 gars/_system/integrity.py; git log -1 --format=%B
grep -n "load_tests" -A30 tests/run_tests.py | head -60; grep -n "estimate\|integrity" tests/run_tests.py | head -30

mkdir -p tmp; TMPDIR=./tmp python3 tests/test_integrity_estimate.py -v 2>&1 | tail -5; sed -n 3510,3530p tests/run_tests.py; cat CLAUDE.md | grep -n -i "test" | head -20; ls tests/check_counts.py && head -40 tests/check_counts.py
mkdir -p tmp/prev && git archive HEAD~1 | tar -x -C tmp/prev && cd tmp/prev && TMPDIR=../ timeout 300 python3 tests/check_counts.py 2>&1 | tail -3

cd ..; cat > review.json <<'EOF'
{"note": "review body omitted"}
EOF
python3 -m json.tool review.json >/dev/null && echo ok
